description:
Meditation Music | Sarangi Instrumental for Deep Calm | 1.5 Hours

For evenings when your nervous system is still humming from the day — this is your reset.

90 minutes of slow, soulful Sarangi (the Hindustani bowed instrument closest to the human voice) designed to help your body and mind settle. Ideal for meditation, deep breathing, or simply letting the day go.

What you'll hear:
• Slow Sarangi — vocal-like, expressive, low register
• Soft tanpura drone beneath
• Recorded warm and acoustic, no electronic processing
• No sudden shifts, no buildup — pure sustained presence

Best for:
• Evening meditation practice
• Nervous system regulation
• Vagus nerve reset after high-stress days
• Winding down before sleep
• Emotional release and grounding

Breathe in. Breathe out. Let it settle.
